description:
Search 26 completed seasons of NOAA NHC HURDAT2 best-track history (2000–2025), Atlantic and eastern/central Pacific. Includes tropical cyclones, not only hurricanes. Filter by basin, year range, name, storm ID, hurricane strength or recorded landfall. Paginated summaries by default; includeTrack=true returns UTC positions, sustained wind kt, pressure mb, status, special-event flags and 34/50/64 kt wind radii in nautical miles ordered NE, SE, SW, NW. Missing measurements are null. Landfall flags cover any coastline, not specifically the US. Finalized retrospective tracks are not forecasts; current 2026 advisories use get_hurricanes. Historical tracks alone do not measure local damage or future risk.

Units: sustained wind kt; pressure mb; coordinates degrees; UTC track timestamps; wind radii nautical miles ordered NE, SE, SW, NW. Missing measurements are null. Returns data and source/freshness metadata.
name: get_hurricane_history
title: Historical hurricane tracks (26 seasons)
